texts.arguments: 2. Mr.Sakhare, on taking instructions from the officials of the Municipal Corporation and present in court, says that every single party, who is before this court, either the petitioner or the intervener, is free to give any suggestions to the Municipal Corporation officials in-charge of implementation of this policy and that the Municipal Corporation is not so rigid or inflexible as not to accept the reasonable view or suggestion and thereupon modify or change any of the terms and conditions in this policy. J.V.SALUNKE,PS 906-WP.3195.2018.doc 3.
